market.question: Will Natural Gas (NG) hit (LOW) $2.60 in May?

assessment.reasoning: Natural gas trading $2.82-$2.86/MMBtu in early May 2026, near 4-week high but recently hit 1.5-year low. Hitting $2.60 LOW in May requires ~8-9% decline from current. Production cuts (EQT) and softer LNG flows support prices, but mild temperatures limit demand. Plausible but not certain.
assessment.key_uncertainty: LNG export rebound vs production cuts vs weather
